title: Director of Engineering, Organizations & Cells
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
 Overview of the Role
 GitLab.com is being rebuilt as a horizontally scalable cluster. Two primitives make that possible: Organizations , the tenant boundary that makes a customer's data a single addressable, portable unit, and Cells , independent GitLab instances that host those Organizations and can be provisioned on demand across clouds and regions.
 The target is a 100x increase in headroom for GitLab.com, delivered without customers ever seeing a cell. Same domain, same URLs, same product — a substrate underneath that scales by adding capacity rather than by negotiating with a single database.

title: Talent Attraction Partner
description:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!
 At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.
 Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.
 Read our blog to learn more.
 About the role...
 We’re looking for a Talent Attraction Partner to partner closely with our industry-leading recruiting team, driving both outbound and referral talent efforts. In this role, you’ll be on the front lines of identifying, engaging, and inspiring top engineering talent to join our mission.
 🧠 You will...
 Partner with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to develop and implement tailored sourcing strategies for high-volume technical roles, with a key focus on mobile and software engineering.
 Proactively build and maintain a strong pipeline of top-tier technical talent using a mix of outbound sourcing and CRM re-engagement
 Attend intake meetings to deeply understand each role’s requirements
 Conduct recruiter screens to evaluate technical alignment and share calibrated recommendations with the hiring manager.
 Own the creation of market maps and talent intelligence reports that provide total addressable market (TAM) insights, inform sourcing strategies, and help prioritize pipeline efforts.
 Run A/B tests on outreach strategies and continuously iterate to improve candidate funnel performance.
 Balance speed and precision, reaching out to volume at scale without sacrificing personalization or quality of engagement.
 ✅ You have...
 A Bachelor’s degree

title: Lead, Technical Account Management (Travel, New Markets)
description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.
 In this role you will lead a team of our world class Technical Account Managers (TAMs), representing and supporting our SMB merchants. As the manager, you will oversee a talented team of TAMs who are responsible for the technical success of our SMB merchants post-sale. You will support and guide your team towards best practice solutions as they advise merchant developers, product teams, and key business partners throughout the entire lifecycle, from initial product integration through expansion and scale. This team is tasked with not only guiding their merchants to avoid pitfalls, but to take advantage of more of Affirm’s offerings; solving business objectives with technical strategies and product optimizations. Technical Account Managers are a part of the Engineering Team and work closely with Affirm’s Client Success, Product Management, Operations, and Merchant Care teams.
 What you'll do
 Coach, mentor and develop an awesome group of experienced TAMs who support our SMB merchants.
 Work closely with our Client Success counterparts to help our network of merchants grow, by not only enabling an efficient time to market, but also by taking better advantage of Affirm’s expanding product suite post launch
 Establish and track team OKRs and goals, establishing proactive action plans for meeting goals when needed
 Forecast the demand for TAMs and recruit as necessary
 Technically, you will evaluate new hires on their technical capabilities, handle escalations from your own team, provide guidance to the TAMs on integration solutions, troubleshooting and optimization opportunities, and be seen as an expert by our customers
 Be a strong internal advocate for our merchants, working cross functionally to make sure their highest priorities are being met

title: Business Development Desk Manager
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.
 Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.
 About the team + role
 The Business Development Desk is a proactive outbound sales team responsible for general asset gathering and migrating customers into our Concierge program through consolidation of assets. This team serves as brand ambassadors, education and creating awareness of all the available products and solutions available that would help the customer reach their financial goals. The team works closely with all of our customer facing teams to ensure a truly white glove/Concierge experience through the onboarding process. In this role, you will lead a team responsible for growing assets and expanding customer relationships here at Robinhood..
 As a Manager of Business Development, you will lead, coach, and develop a team of Onboarding Specialists who support customers throughout their onboarding journey while also exploring any additional opportunities to consolidate/win more share of wallet. You will oversee and enhance sales pipelines, review opportunities worked for Compliance and Oversight and coaching to overall sales process and customer experience.
 You will be responsible for driving team strategy, establishing operating efficiency, and driving asset growth through pipeline management and ongoing coaching and development of sales agents. In addition to developing your team, you will partner closely with product, compliance, legal, and external service providers to evolve the Business Development Desk offering, expand pipelines of opportunities and ensure all customer interactions meet all regulatory standards including RegBI and telemarketing compliance.
 This is a highly cross-functional leadership role whe…
